themes.name: Server attitude and attentiveness
themes.description: How friendly, rude, attentive, knowledgeable, or neglectful servers, bartenders and hosts were toward guests, including the tag-team multiple-server approach and being ignored or flagged down.

themes.name: Wait times and reservations
themes.description: Waits to be seated, honoring of reservations and walk-in policies, hostess handling of seating and party size, and how hard it was to get a table.

themes.name: Pacing of the meal
themes.description: Timing of courses and drinks, including food arriving all at once or too fast, being rushed out with the check, long gaps between dishes, and slow kitchen output.

themes.name: Bread and rolls
themes.description: The complimentary dinner rolls and bread, including their quality, whether they were offered or withheld, and difficulty getting refills.

themes.name: Oysters
themes.description: The wood-fired chili garlic butter oysters, including flavor, sauce, size, portion count and temperature.

themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: The fried alligator appetizer, including texture, seasoning, sauce and whether it was a good way to try gator.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon signature dish
themes.description: The pulled pork Louisiana Cochon entree with cabbage, cracklins and turnips, including its moisture, saltiness, flavor and presentation.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: The rabbit and dumplings entree, including how the stew tasted, the dumplings, the amount of rabbit, and comparisons to chicken pot pie.

themes.name: Ribs, ham hock and pork cheeks
themes.description: Reviews of the smoked pork ribs, ham hock and braised pork cheeks, including tenderness, sauce, seasoning and fat.

themes.name: Mac and cheese and sides
themes.description: The side dishes such as macaroni and cheese casserole, grits, greens, lima beans, twice-baked potato and shrimp and eggplant dressing.

themes.name: Saltiness and seasoning
themes.description: Whether dishes across the menu were over-salted, bland, over-sauced, too vinegary or spicy, or well balanced.

themes.name: Prices and portion size
themes.description: Whether the cost felt fair or high relative to portion sizes, a la carte pricing and value, including check totals.

themes.name: Atmosphere and noise
themes.description: The restaurant's decor, vibe, noise level, seating comfort and layout, including bench seating, crowded tables, temperature and outdoor seating.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: Quality, strength and pricing of cocktails, beer, wine, bourbon, moonshine and non-alcoholic drinks, plus the drink menu and glassware.

themes.name: Dietary accommodations and substitutions
themes.description: How the restaurant handled vegetarian options, allergies, menu modifications, substitutions, special requests and split checks.

themes.name: Hype and expectations
themes.description: Whether the restaurant met reviewers' expectations given its reviews, awards, and TV coverage, including tourist-trap perceptions and comparisons to Cochon Butcher and other New Orleans restaurants.

themes.name: Cleanliness and food safety
themes.description: Concerns about hygiene, foreign objects in food, pests, dirty tableware, cross-contamination and illness after eating.
